name: ollama_shell
description: A powerful AI-integrated Terminal Shell powered by the Ollama LLM interface.

paragraphs: A local-first AI that lives on your machine, uses your tools, and keeps your secrets.

No API keys. No cloud round-trips. No telemetry. Just a capable, agentic model running on your own hardware — one that can read your files, run your shell, search the web when you ask, write you a report, drive a hidden browser… and, when the room goes quiet, sit there and daydream.
The only things that ever touch the network are tools you can see the model call — web search, fetch, Atlassian — each flagged in a privacy banner. Nothing phones home on its own. Ever.
